problem:
The velocity $v$ at time $t$ of a particle $P$ moving in the $xy$-plane is given by

$$
v(t)=⟨8(1+2t)^{3},\,4t⟩,\,t\in (0,\infty ).
$$

Given that the particle is at the position $r=⟨1,\,-2⟩$ when $t=0,$ find the times when the particle intersects the $x$-axis. Do not round the answer.

The particle intersects the $x$-axis when $t=$
{{field-1}}.
